description: Throw away the current world and build one from a scenario: a ready-made one by name (see twin_list_scenarios), or your own YAML (seed, startTime, world, faults, auth, timeline). Give one of the two. A scenario that doesn't load leaves the twin as it was. twin_reset comes back to its start. Answers with the new status.

name.description: A ready-made scenario's name, like flaky-apis

yaml.description: A whole scenario as YAML, instead of a name
